Ivy: noticed a tiny billing bump from reconnect storms on APAC edges this morning.
Sam: Any traces?
Ivy: Example: trace=tr-7 resume=rz9 seq=21 upstream=apac-1 billed=15
Ivy: same resume 2s later upstream=apac-2 billed=17
Maya: Probable causes: route tag canonicalization differences + proxy header whitespace + mixed SDK reconnect timing.
DevInfraBot: Note: router v2026.05.01 started appending region suffix to route tags.
Sam: Fast mitigation: meter canonicalizer to trim+lower resume ids + 10s dedupe window behind flag. Rollout canary 5% APAC.
Maya: Longer-term: seq-guard in meter: keep last_seen_seq per resume, suppress billing if incoming seq <= last_seen_seq, TTL 30s. That avoids counting continuing streams as duplicates.
billing-bot: If duplicates confirmed, billing will credit accounts for obvious windows >1000 tokens.
Ivy: Action items: Sam -> PR for canonicalizer+dedeupe + start canary. Maya -> console panel showing duplicate_resume_rate and alert. Sam -> post Grafana links during canary.
Sam: Starting canary now (meter-dedupe-v3) -> 5% APAC. Monitoring duplicate_resume_rate and billed_tokens_delta.
Maya: Page SRE if billed_tokens_delta > 5000 in 10m APAC.
billing-bot: Alert created: apac-billing-delta (sensitivity=high).
